stories.title: Long-awaited trial begins in rapper Tupac Shakur’s 1996 Las Vegas killing
stories.summary: Rapper Tupac Shakur was shot dead in an act of gang revenge ordered by a mobster who later boasted of it, jurors heard on Monday, as one of America’s most anticipated trials got under way, 30 years after the murder.
